# Set79 Path C headless actual

Source-only external harness; root reviews the exact manifests and execution
lock before running. It reuses Path A's qualified independent reference and
financial assertions without generating another oracle. `provenance.json`
binds the inherited sources. Paths A and B remain unchanged.

One real `slugpilot --daily` child owns original fixture login/Start. The parent
owns its exact PID, pipe/log joins and single SIGTERM; any nonzero exit, output
failure or forced cleanup fails. After that process joins, a stopped concrete
controller observes the same original wallet through the real scheduled payout.
The complete public audits retain all pending work and issuance hold. See
`PLAN.md` for the exact1/2 reward branches and original900/1080/180 limits.

The runner separately binds the node, probe and CLI compiled closures and
candidate build metadata. Protected generated fixture trees are retained;
only the named public reports/status streams are evidence for publication.
No Go, network, private input access or runtime was performed during authoring.

After root approval, the intended invocation is:

```sh
python3 /Users/taytrrip/slug/set79-prep/public-daily-headless/run.py \
  --execute --approved-lock /absolute/path/to/execution-lock.approved.json \
  --approved-lock-sha256 EXACT_APPROVED_SHA256 \
  --attempt public-daily-headless-actual-attempt1
```

An existing proposed lock is not execution authorization. Qualified product
successors must be rebound before approval. Preserve every failed attempt.

The preserved `pre-money-read` successor adds only bounded pure money-read
retries and partial-payment/refusal evidence; see `MONEY_READ_SUCCESSOR.md`.
